why.visual_craft: Both variants apply identical visual treatment to heading, labels, message body, and button styling. No distinguishing visual craft difference.
why.spacing_rhythm: 4E88 provides slightly more generous breathing between the provenance metadata line and the action buttons, creating a more relaxed vertical rhythm.
why.information_hierarchy: Both variants present information in identical order and visual weight: question → channel/sender → body → source → actions.
why.preview_readability: Message content and all metadata are equally legible in both variants. No readability advantage.
why.provenance_visibility: Source line (出所) and its metadata are presented with equal prominence and clarity in both.
why.control_reachability: Cancel, Edit, and 送る buttons are positioned identically and equally accessible.
why.overall: 4E88 edges ahead due to marginally better spacing proportion in the gap below the source line, which feels more intentional and comfortable. A15D is nearly equivalent, but that tighter gap reads as slightly compressed.
